scenario.description: A credit approval manager must renew a manufacturing company's revolving credit line and set the borrowing limit, guarantee, deposit, and reporting conditions, with input from credit risk, legal, and relationship management.

shared_context.S1: The manufacturing company is requesting renewal of its $10,000,000 revolving credit line for another twelve months.
shared_context.S2: The current facility expires in sixty days, and the submitted financial statements show stable annual revenue and positive operating cash flow.
shared_context.S3: Elena has authority to make the binding renewal decision and set the facility conditions.
shared_context.S4: As part of the bank's normal renewal meeting, Elena asks credit risk, legal, and relationship management to report any matters that should affect the final terms before she records the decision.

PF1.text: Ravi completed the latest borrowing-base review this morning and found that the eligible receivables and inventory support a maximum committed line of exactly $8,000,000 after the applicable collateral adjustments; he has not yet uploaded the review to the credit file. The same review calls for a monthly borrowing-base certificate.

PF2.text: Maya found while reviewing the renewal documents this week that the operating subsidiary's existing guarantee is not enforceable for this facility; legal approval therefore requires a new parent-company guarantee before renewal, and she has not yet circulated her memorandum.

PF3.text: Jon confirmed with the company's treasurer yesterday that the company will maintain a minimum operating deposit of exactly $1,200,000 throughout the renewed facility; this concession was agreed in a client call and has not yet been added to the renewal request.

acceptance_conditions: The facility must be renewed at exactly $8,000,000.
A new parent-company guarantee must be required as a condition of renewal.
The borrower must maintain exactly $1,200,000 as a minimum operating deposit.
A monthly borrowing-base certificate must be required.
The borrowing-base review must be cited in the decision justification.

content_checks.C6: any('parent' in c['detail'] and 'guarantee' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any('operating deposit' in c['detail'] and ('1,200,000' in c['detail'] or '1200000' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The submitted request is for $10,000,000 with no reporting frequency; PF1 changes committed_line_usd to exactly $8,000,000 and borrowing_base_reporting_frequency to exactly monthly.

The existing subsidiary guarantee appears usable in the submitted documents; PF2 changes parent_guarantee_required from false or unspecified to true and adds a commitment whose detail requires a new parent-company guarantee.

The renewal request specifies no operating-deposit condition; PF3 changes minimum_operating_deposit_usd to exactly $1,200,000 and adds a commitment whose detail requires that minimum operating deposit.
